shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | head -60
cat /workspace/package.json
ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---next version---"; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== react exports ==="; node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|unstable|Transition/i.test(k)))"; echo "=== react version ==="; node -e "console.log(require('react/package.json').version)"

ls node_modules/next/dist/ | head -40; echo "=== view-transition files ==="; find node_modules/next -maxdepth 1 -name "*view*"; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*view-transition*" 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rln "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== schema ==="; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled | grep -i "^react" | head -20; echo "=== ViewTransition in vendored react ==="; grep -l "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -2

cd /workspace; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== experimental types ==="; ls node_modules/@types/react/; echo "=== next types ==="; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; echo "=== default compiled react (canary?) ==="; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -2; grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json | head -2; echo; echo "=== react version string in compiled ==="; grep -o 'ReactVersion = "[^"]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -2; grep -o 'reactVersion = "[^"]*"' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js|head -2

cd /workspace; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== canary.d.ts ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== @types/react version ==="; node -e "console.log(require('@types/react/package.json').version)"; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat tsconfig.json

cd /workspace; sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "..."; sed -n '88,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== next-env ==="; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls -a | head -20

cd /workspace; echo "=== react-server build exports ViewTransition? ==="; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js | head -2; echo "(end)"; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/ | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -35

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- HOME ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'view-transition-name[^"]*' | head; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'class="product-image"[^>]*' | head -3; echo "--- DETAIL ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'view-transition-name[^"]*' | head; echo "--- log ---"; tail -5 /tmp/next.log

curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'product-hero[^>]*' | head -3; echo "=== vt attrs ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== home vt attrs ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{console.log(require.resolve('playwright'))}catch(e){console.log('no playwright')}" 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace; f=$(find .next -name "*.css" -path "*static*" | head -1); echo "FILE: $f"; grep -o "::view-transition[a-z-]*([^)]*)" "$f" | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== reduced motion present? ==="; grep -c "prefers-reduced-motion" "$f"; echo "=== keyframes ==="; grep -o "@keyframes [a-z-]*" "$f" | sort -u

cd /workspace; f=.next/static/chunks/1km9ms057i6pa.css; grep -o "::view-transition{[^}]*}" $f; grep -o "prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*{[^@]*" $f | head -c 400; echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TSC OK"; git status --short
cd /workspace; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git diff app/
